title: Password reset flow
tagline: Reset links expire too fast, work twice, and miss emails typed in capitals.
lookFor: Emails: trim spaces and make them lowercase before you look them up.
Changing a value you loaded does not save it. You must write it back to the database.

bugs.symptom: Reset email not sent when the email's case differs
hints: Saved emails are lowercase. What is searched when someone types 'Asha@Example.com'?
Where does every email lookup go through?
bugs.cause: The lookup uses the email exactly as typed. 'Asha@Example.com' is not 'asha@example.com', so no user is found.

hints: What unit does `clock.now()` use? What unit is `TTL_MINUTES * 60`?
bugs.cause: `now + 15 * 60` adds 900 milliseconds, not 15 minutes. The link dies in under a second.

hints: Look at the last line of `resetPassword`. Does `record.used = true` reach the database?
bugs.cause: `record.used = true` only changes the copy in memory. Nothing is saved, so the link keeps working.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: An exactly-8-character password is rejected
hints: Rule: at least 8. Code: rejects when length <= 8. What happens at exactly 8?
bugs.cause: `<= 8` rejects 8. The rule says 8 is fine.
